calibration.source: USGS GP-1012 (Saltus & Jachens 1995, doi:10.3133/gp1012); Blakely & Jachens 1991 doi:10.1130/0016-7606(1991)103<0795:RSOMRI>2.3.CO;2

divergence_finding: The full Parker-Oldenburg non-linear iteration does NOT converge on this input. Iteration 1 leaves the smallest forward residual; every later correction raises it and the relief then grows without bound. An isostatic RESIDUAL carries crustal- and mantle-scale field, and a single-interface Parker series can only absorb that field as relief, so it does. The lane therefore uses the first iterate (low-passed Bouguer slab) and reports the rejected correction instead of hiding it.

inversion.stage: first iterate (low-passed Bouguer slab); non-linear correction rejected because it diverges on an isostatic residual

cross_check_vs_published_depth.note: a high r with a slope near 1 says the inversion reproduces the supplied product; it is a check, not an input
